title: Typography—Sans Serif: Futura
slide_intent: Teach designers to judge apparent size from the letters people see. Nominal point size alone does not account for Futura’s small x-height.
strategic_value: NASA can use the geometric character of Futura in a catalog or technical brochure while keeping its hierarchy readable.
demonstration: Futura Light and Demibold character sets sit above two text settings. The introduction compares the apparent size of 11-point Futura with 10-point Helvetica.
practical_value: Size Futura by comparing its lowercase letters at reading scale and pair its text with Futura Demibold headings.

content_islands.name: Size and pairing guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the header columns to connect Futura to the intended publication and explain its x-height and heading choice.

content_islands.name: Weight specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack Light and Demibold alphabets, numbers and punctuation in the middle. Keep the label with each specimen.

content_islands.name: Column examples
content_islands.spec: Set a broad text measure at left and a narrow one at right. Use Futura Demibold for their headings and retain the annotations identifying the settings.
